These updates, required by the FDA, incorporate the estimated incidence of these conditions following the 2023-2024 vaccine formula and the results of a study on cardiac MRI in affected individuals according to the FDA. The information is also included in the Adverse Reactions section and in materials for recipients and caregivers. The risk of myocarditis is reportedly higher in young men, according to a YouTube video from July 1, 2025.
